body:
Yes, it should just prefix the field in general to avoid this issue.
But I could not reproduce this. It seems that the `?sort=id` addition in the URL always makes the order table-alias-prefixed in my case.

Hey @dereuromark - just checked it on CakePHP 3.05 and it was doing it alright.

?sort=id&direction=asc

Is the URL.

Let me know if you need any more info to help with this.
What is the generated query that breaks?

LEFT JOIN clients Clients ON Clients.id = (Campaigns.client_id)

You can see the:

```
ORDER BY id asc
```

At the end, which is the cause.
I can fix that. The paginator should be adding the alias when possible.

I tried to reproduce this with 3.0.5, and I wasn't able to. I started with a baked app, and added `contain` options.  Sorting by a duplicate column (id) did not generate a SQL error as the sort column was prefixed correctly.

Hey @markstory - anything I could do to provide this in more detail?  Can you give me an indication where this is in the CakePHP library, I will try to debug this myself and see if I can find anything.

Thanks again.

> anything I could do to provide this in more detail?

Reproduction steps.

I suggest to have a look what the options are [where the find call is](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Controller/Component/PaginatorComponent.php#L163-L167) - then determine why in your case [this isn't executed](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Controller/Component/PaginatorComponent.php#L333-L349) - or if it is, the reason the order clause is generated without an alias.

Also I find this confusing:

> Hey @dereuromark - just checked it on CakePHP 3.05 and it was doing it alright.
> 
> ?sort=id&direction=asc
> 
> Is the URL.

If 3.0.5 is doing it correctly - in what version is there an error?
@MichaelHoughton that isn't a valid version number, branch or tag.

The only thing I could imagine happening, would be https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Controller/Component/PaginatorComponent.php#L336-L337
That you have some custom sort on top with a numeric index which makes the prefixing skip.

Do you have any special setup on top?
